You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 34 of 50 (script duration 190.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
E26: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
E27: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
E28: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
E29: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
E30: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
E31: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
E32: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
E33: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
Direct lead-in to E34: Following the aristocratic Lord's ruthless extortion of the young maid in his study, Episode 34 transitions directly into the crowded courtroom trial where the conspirators unleash their manufactured charges and false witnesses against Lady Juliana.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.8] SCREEN: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.
[L002 1.2-7.8] JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
[L003 2.8-7.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.
[L004 7.8-13.1] SCREEN: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
[L005 9.0-11.2] SFX: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
[L006 9.1-12.6] JUDGE (Inquisitive, Severe): "Do you deny possessing this book?"
[L007 13.1-15.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
[L008 13.8-14.8] LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching): "No."
[L009 15.5-19.4] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.
[L010 15.6-19.2] JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory): "Do you deny using its remedies?"
[L011 19.4-23.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.
[L012 20.8-21.8] LADY JULIANA (Firm): "No."
[L013 23.8-27.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
[L014 27.4-31.7] SCREEN: Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.
[L015 27.5-31.2] JUDGE (Hard, Pressing): "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
[L016 31.7-35.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.
[L017 33.2-35.1] LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified): "I admit to healing the sick."
[L018 35.3-37.4] ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
[L019 35.4-36.6] JUDGE (Furious, Shouting): "Silence!"
[L020 35.8-37.0] SFX: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
[L021 35.8-37.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
[L022 37.4-42.5] SCREEN: Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.
[L023 37.5-41.2] JUDGE (Commanding): "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
[L024 41.0-43.0] ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
[L025 42.5-44.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.
[L026 43.2-44.6] PRUDENCE (Trembling, Tearful): "Yes, Your Honor."
[L027 44.8-49.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.
[L028 45.3-48.8] JUDGE (Probing, Formal): "Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?"
[L029 49.0-51.5] SCREEN: Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.
[L030 49.1-50.5] LADY JULIANA (Softly, Urgent): "Tell the truth."
[L031 51.5-54.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.
[L032 53.0-54.2] PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Heartbroken): "Yes."
[L033 54.8-57.6] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
[L034 57.6-60.8] SCREEN: Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.
[L035 58.2-60.1] JUDGE (Measured, Stern): "What did you see?"
[L036 60.8-64.6] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.
[L037 61.3-64.4] PRUDENCE (Choked with Tears): "She used herbs... and her mother's book."
[L038 64.6-66.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.
[L039 64.8-66.7] JUDGE (Pressing, Sharp): "Did she draw strange markings?"
[L040 66.8-71.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.
[L041 68.2-71.7] PRUDENCE (Faltering, Desperate): "She... placed herbs around my brother's bed."
[L042 71.8-75.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.
[L043 72.1-75.5] JUDGE (Accusatory, Forceful): "And did she speak words you could not understand?"
[L044 75.8-81.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.
[L045 78.8-80.5] PRUDENCE (Weeping, Shaken): "Yes."
[L046 81.0-85.2] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.
[L047 81.3-84.9] LORD (Triumphant, Smug): "Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual."
[L048 85.0-87.2] ACTION: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
[L049 85.2-87.4] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.
[L050 85.2-87.2] LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Indignant): "It was not a ritual!"
[L051 87.2-90.2] ACTION: The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
[L052 87.4-90.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[L053 87.8-89.2] SFX: [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]
[L054 87.9-90.0] JUDGE (Bellowing): "You will speak when addressed!"
[L055 90.5-93.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.
[L056 91.0-93.2] LORD (Calm, Poisonous): "We have further witnesses."
[L057 93.8-98.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.
[L058 94.2-98.0] TOWNSMAN (Nervous, Fearful): "My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures..."
[L059 98.2-99.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.
[L060 98.3-99.1] JUDGE (Sharp): "And?"
[L061 99.5-102.1] SCREEN: Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.
[L062 99.8-101.8] TOWNSMAN (Agitated): "She became violently ill."
[L063 102.1-107.3] SCREEN: Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.
[L064 102.3-107.0] OLD WOMAN (Shrill, Accusatory): "My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!"
[L065 107.3-110.0] SCREEN: Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.
[L066 108.0-109.8] LORD (Mocking, Smug): "She calls it healing."
[L067 110.0-112.8] ACTION: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
[L068 110.0-112.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.
[L069 110.1-112.6] LORD (Resonant, Vindicative): "The people call it poisoning!"
[L070 112.8-115.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.
[L071 113.2-115.0] LADY JULIANA (Incisive, Defiant): "What were their illnesses?"
[L072 115.2-117.2] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.
[L073 115.3-116.5] LORD (Dismissive): "Irrelevant."
[L074 117.2-119.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.
[L075 117.4-119.6] LADY JULIANA (Fierce): "It is not irrelevant!"
[L076 119.8-123.4] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.
[L077 119.9-123.2] LADY JULIANA (Clear, Unyielding): "Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!"
[L078 123.4-126.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.
[L079 123.6-126.4] JUDGE (Coldly Inquisitive): "You admit you administered them?"
[L080 126.8-129.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.
[L081 127.2-128.2] LADY JULIANA (Direct): "Yes."
[L082 129.1-131.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.
[L083 129.3-131.6] JUDGE (Challenging): "Without the approval of a licensed physician?"
[L084 131.8-134.6] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.
[L085 132.1-134.4] LADY JULIANA (Steely, Earnest): "There was no physician willing to help them."
[L086 134.6-139.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.
[L087 136.2-138.4] LADY JULIANA (Calm, Resolute): "So I helped them."
[L088 139.2-142.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.
[L089 139.6-142.0] LORD (Derisive): "Even now, she refuses to repent."
[L090 142.2-147.4] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.
[L091 142.4-147.0] JUDGE (Grave, Stern): "Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices."
[L092 147.4-148.9] SCREEN: Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
[L093 148.9-151.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.
[L094 149.8-150.8] LADY JULIANA (Unyielding): "No."
[L095 151.2-154.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.
[L096 151.8-153.8] JUDGE (Ominous, Warning): "Think carefully."
[L097 154.8-156.8] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.
[L098 155.2-156.4] LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): "I have."
[L099 156.8-162.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.
[L100 157.0-161.8] JUDGE (Severe, Imposing): "You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?"
[L101 162.0-163.6] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.
[L102 162.1-163.5] LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless): "Then let it be."
[L103 163.6-166.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
[L104 164.0-166.8] ACTION: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
[L105 166.8-174.4] SCREEN: Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.
[L106 167.0-173.6] LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant): "Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."
[L107 174.4-176.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.
[L108 176.5-178.2] ACTION: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
[L109 176.5-178.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.
[L110 176.6-177.6] SFX: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]
[L111 177.8-179.4] JUDGE (Thunderous): "Enough!"
[L112 179.5-184.5] ACTION: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
[L113 179.5-184.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.
[L114 181.0-184.2] JUDGE (Booming, Solemn): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."
[L115 184.5-190.0] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.
[L116 185.0-190.0] ACTION: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "Trial of the Witch", "segments": [{"start_line": "L001", "end_line": "L002"}, {"start_line": "L113", "end_line": "L116"}], "hook_line": "L002", "hook": "The Judge immediately charges the protagonist with witchcraft and poisoning, setting the stakes of a death sentence.", "hook_quote": "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.", "cliffhanger_line": "L116", "cliffhanger": "The Judge raises his hand to deliver the final sentence; will she be condemned to death?", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "Courtroom drama is a powerful hook, and the threat of the gallows keeps the viewer engaged.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 9}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "Trial of the Witch": total duration 18.3 s is outside 20-60 s

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
